tldr: Venus through the 2nd house brings focus to money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Venus transiting the 2nd house softens money, resources, values, and self-worth. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports earning and resourcing: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or equating worth with what is owned or earned.
advice: Receive and refine in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
